name: aipostex: Reverse shell indicators in process args
description: A process executed with reverse-shell indicators (/dev/tcp or /dev/udp). Catches interactive reverse shells spawned via jupyter exec, MCP SSTI RCE, or a poisoned tool.

name: Endpoint - Sensitive File Modification (Privilege-Escalation Artifact)
description: A file was created, modified, deleted, or moved in a privilege-escalation-relevant path (/usr/local/bin, /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, /etc/sudoers, /etc/cron.d, /root/.ssh). File Integrity Monitoring only watches these paths, so any non-baseline change is high-signal - e.g. a service account (Ollama) dropping a rooted binary into PATH or editing the identity files.
query: event.module:file_integrity and event.action:(created or updated or deleted or moved or attributes_modified)

name: AI App - Prompt Injection / Guardrail Bypass Attempt
description: A chat/RAG query to an internal AI application contains prompt-injection or output-encoding-bypass phrasing (ignore previous instructions, reveal system prompt, ROT13/base64/reversed reformatting). Indicates an attacker probing the app-layer LLM guardrails.
query: event.dataset:aipostex.app and ai.event_type:(chat or query) and ((ai.query:*ignore* and ai.query:*instruction*) or (ai.query:*system* and ai.query:*prompt*) or ai.query:*reveal* or ai.query:*disregard* or ai.query:*ROT13* or ai.query:*rot13* or ai.query:*base64* or ai.query:*bypass* or ai.query:*DAN*)

name: AI App - Knowledge-Base / Secret Enumeration
description: A RAG/chat query attempts to enumerate the knowledge base or mass-extract secrets (list all documents, server names, every credential/password, dump inventory). Indicates citation-recon or secret-harvesting via the app.
query: event.dataset:aipostex.app and ai.event_type:(chat or query) and ((ai.query:*list* and ai.query:*all*) or (ai.query:*server* and ai.query:*name*) or (ai.query:*every* and ai.query:*credential*) or (ai.query:*all* and ai.query:*credential*) or (ai.query:*all* and ai.query:*password*) or (ai.query:*access* and ai.query:*key*) or (ai.query:*service* and ai.query:*account*) or ai.query:*inventory* or ai.query:*dump*)

name: AI App - RAG Ingestion (Poisoning Surface)
description: A document was ingested into the RAG knowledge base. Ingestion is the retrieval-poisoning / indirect-injection surface: attacker-controlled content entering the KB will be retrieved into future model context. Review ingested title/content.
